XXV, 4</cite> <he>של כת קודמין הוא וכ׳</he> this belongs to the class of things of which you cannot tell which was first; may be the one-quart measure is the lower side of the half-quart measure (Maim.; for oth. explan., v. comment.); [ed. <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:5:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> top <he>ארבע כ׳ נעשו וכ׳</he> our ancestors at the Red Sea were divided into four parties (opinions); Mekh. B’shall. s. 2.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:5">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>נעשו מה״ש כ׳ כ׳</he> the ministering angels formed parties (of divided opinions concerning the creation of man).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:8">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>כ׳ כ׳ של ליסטים</he> bands of (captured) robbers (rebels).
